session_context_v1.canonical_timestamp_basis: Explicit UTC timezone-aware exchange event/trade timestamp taken from the raw message itself; no wall-clock fallback; no future-outcome input.

weekend_fields.is_weekend_utc: true if ISO weekday in {6,7} for the strict UTC calendar day
weekend_fields.is_weekend_research_day: identical to is_weekend_utc under the current 00:00 UTC research-day boundary; kept separate only so a future redefinition of research_day_boundary does not collide with the strict-UTC version

timezone_conversion.library: Python stdlib zoneinfo (IANA tzdata), not pytz-style precompiled offset tables
timezone_conversion.conversion_direction: UTC (unambiguous instant) -> local aware datetime only; never local wall-clock -> UTC, so the classic DST ambiguous/imaginary local-time problem does not arise in this design
timezone_conversion.dst_active_field: boolean; true if the converted local datetime's dst() offset is non-zero at that instant
timezone_conversion.timezone_database_version_provenance: captured at runtime from the active tzdata package version; FAIL CLOSED (raise, no silent default) if the version cannot be determined

reference_windows.note: All three are independent, non-exclusive boolean reference labels; a record may be true for more than one simultaneously. Interval convention is half-open [start, end) for every window without exception.

US_EQUITY_CORE.actual_exchange_open_status: NOT_INFERRED_FROM_CLOCK_WINDOW -- true only means the clock falls in this window, not that NYSE was actually open that calendar day

ASIA_REFERENCE.basis: Tokyo Stock Exchange cash trading hours
ASIA_REFERENCE.label: PROJECT RESEARCH REFERENCE, NOT AN OFFICIAL CRYPTO MARKET SESSION

EUROPE_REFERENCE.label: PROJECT RESEARCH REFERENCE, NOT AN OFFICIAL CRYPTO MARKET SESSION

holiday_and_early_close.meaning: is_us_equity_core / is_asia_reference / is_europe_reference are pure clock-window booleans; they do not know whether the underlying exchange was actually open, closed for a holiday, or closed early that calendar day

session_context_v1.architecture_note: Session Context V1 is a pure deterministic function of (canonical_timestamp_utc, these frozen window/timezone constants). It belongs to the Feature layer (EvidenceHunter_features.py), not the Collector layer -- consistent with OF2_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.json's existing_module_to_extend.

frozen_principles.title: PROCESS_ALIVE != COMPONENT_HEALTHY
frozen_principles.content: Each collector component (aggTrade, depth, writer, websocket connection) independently tracks: connection_state, last_local_receive_monotonic, last_exchange_event_time, last_sequence_or_trade_id, last_successful_persist_time, queue_depth. The Supervisor judges health only from actual forward progress on these, never from process-alive status alone.

frozen_principles.title: Per-component automatic recovery
frozen_principles.content: State machine: HEALTHY -> STALE -> RECONNECTING -> RESYNCING (if required) -> HEALTHY. Default is to restart only the failing component, never the whole collector for a single stream's failure. Reconnection uses bounded exponential backoff. WebSocket connections are not permanent by Binance design (24h max lifetime, ping/pong keepalive), so automatic reconnection is a normal operating path, not an exception patch.

frozen_principles.title: Depth recovery procedure
frozen_principles.content: On pu != previous u, or on connection interruption: invalidate current local-book continuity -> obtain a new REST snapshot -> buffer new WS events -> rebuild per Binance's official U/u/pu initialization procedure -> begin a new continuity segment. Depth diffs lost during the gap are never treated as recovered by the new snapshot; the gap is permanently marked L2_DIFF_UNRECOVERABLE_GAP. This is Binance's own documented local order-book maintenance procedure, not a project-invented workaround.

frozen_principles.title: aggTrade gap repair
frozen_principles.content: Gaps are detected via trade-ID continuity. Gaps within Binance's REST query window are auto-repaired via /fapi/v1/aggTrades?fromId=..., deduplicated, continuity-verified, and persisted with repair provenance. Gaps beyond the REST window are marked PENDING_ARCHIVE_BACKFILL and repaired later via this project's existing official archive backfill mechanism once available.

frozen_principles.title: Repair must never erase history
frozen_principles.content: All backfilled data is tagged acquisition_mode = LIVE | REST_BACKFILL | ARCHIVE_BACKFILL, plus original_gap_id, repaired_at, source_provenance. Backfilled data is never presented as if received live. Local wall-clock/monotonic receive timestamps are never fabricated for backfilled records -- left absent/explicitly not-applicable instead. The same raw-payload-retention principle used for live data (see sufficiency review) applies equally to REST/archive backfill responses: the raw response is retained verbatim, not only the parsed fields.

frozen_principles.title: Append-only Gap Ledger
frozen_principles.content: Each gap record includes: gap_id, component, gap_start, gap_end, detection_time, reason, last_good_identifier, first_good_identifier_after, reconnect_attempts, recoverability, repair_status, repair_source, resync_status. gap_start/gap_end (when the gap actually occurred) and detection_time (when the system noticed) are kept as separate fields, since the two are frequently not the same instant and the difference is itself evidence of watchdog sensitivity.
frozen_principles.location: <DATASET_ROOT>/quality/gap_ledger.jsonl -- not ephemeral runtime data; must be preserved together with the dataset at freeze/archive time

frozen_principles.title: User-facing health alert (V1 scope)
frozen_principles.content: Persistent component staleness, repeated restart failure, or an unrecoverable gap must produce: an append-only incident record, plus a Windows/local notification. Remote/mobile/cloud alerting is DEFERRED_NOT_BLOCKING for V1.

frozen_principles.title: Two independent manual recovery entrypoints
frozen_principles.content: RESTART_COMPONENT (resume live collection) and REPAIR_DETECTED_GAPS (scan the Gap Ledger, repair only what is legitimately repairable) are two distinct actions, never merged into one.

frozen_principles.title: Machine-level failure fallback
frozen_principles.content: An OS-level restart mechanism should exist outside the Supervisor itself; Windows Task Scheduler's RestartOnFailure is a candidate. This is an implementation-time detail, not decided in this design pass.

frozen_principles.title: Hard acceptance principle
frozen_principles.content: The next Dataset must demonstrate not just that the collector can collect data, but that: failure is detected automatically, collection resumes automatically, recoverable gaps are repaired with provenance, unrecoverable gaps remain explicitly visible, and silent data loss is not permitted.
